title: The Silent Organ
scene: At 3:55 PM, the theater organ key cover was stolen. The organ loft was locked from 3:40 to 4:10.

suspects.name: Hilda Wren
suspects.testimony: I was in the cafe at 3:55, taking a break.
suspects.alibiProof: The cafe receipt for Hilda is stamped 3:54.

suspects.name: Ivor Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the wings at 3:55, checking lights.
suspects.alibiProof: The light board log shows Ivor's cues at 3:52 and 3:58.

suspects.name: Kira Reed
suspects.testimony: I was sweeping the loft at 3:55, as always.
suspects.contradiction: The loft was locked from outside at 3:40, and the velvet cover was in Kira's locker.

suspects.name: Karla Voss
suspects.testimony: I was warming up in the dressing room at 3:55.
suspects.alibiProof: The dressing room camera shows Karla at 3:53 and 3:59.
